headline: Brazilian Copper Processor Paranapanema Delays Third-Quarter Financial Release
summary: Brazilian copper producer Paranapanema postponed the release of its third-quarter 2026 financial statement from its scheduled date to November 27.
why: Paranapanema S.A. is a major Brazilian copper refiner operating under corporate judicial recovery.

impacts.name: Paranapanema
impacts.why: Paranapanema delayed its third-quarter earnings publication date to November 27.
